title: BPO Workforce Analytics & Attrition Prediction
thesis: Snowflake predicts agent attrition across 45 BPO sites, classifies flight-risk employees with ML, surfaces retention drivers with TOP_INSIGHTS, and notifies HR via SES — all native SQL, no external ML platform needed

talking_points: Four hundred twenty million pesos in annual attrition cost across 45 BPO sites.
Three sites — BGC, Cebu IT Park, and Clark — running above 9% monthly attrition.
1,247 agents currently flagged as high flight risk by ML.CLASSIFICATION.
show: Point at the ₱420M attrition cost KPI
Highlight 3 red-status sites on the map

transition.line: Let's drill into what's driving attrition and who's at risk.

talking_points: Cebu IT Park running 11.2% monthly attrition — highest in the network.
TOP_INSIGHTS reveals: commute time > 90 min is the #1 driver, followed by night-shift tenure > 18 months.
ML.CLASSIFICATION: 847 agents in Cebu scored above 0.75 flight risk.
show: Click Cebu IT Park in the site list
tabs.call_out: Commute > 90 min is the #1 attrition driver — not compensation

transition.line: The insight is counterintuitive. Let's see what retention actions we can take.

talking_points: Training completion correlates with 34% lower attrition — programs work.
Agents who received a shift change within 30 days of request have 52% lower flight risk.
Cortex Complete generates personalized retention plans for each at-risk agent.
show: Click an at-risk agent for retention recommendation
tabs.call_out: Shift flexibility reduces attrition 52% — cheaper than a raise

transition.line: Let the CPO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Maria Cristina asks: 'What's our cost of attrition for Cebu this quarter?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: ₱87M in Q3 alone.
Switch to advisor: 'Recommend retention strategy for night-shift agents in Cebu' — generates actionable plan.
show: Type: 'What is the attrition cost for Cebu Q3?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + strategic advisory

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services replaced or complemented.
ML.CLASSIFICATION + TOP_INSIGHTS replace SageMaker for attrition prediction.
Philippines BPO: $32.5B industry, 1.7M workers. This monitors 28,000 agents across 45 sites.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, no ML ops overhead

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine BPO workforce intelligence.
